controlParity: Preview uses the existing current immutable runtime/factory and a readonly future-client overlay with the same authenticated reference and existing networks; no new queue/store/daemon.
Both versions have identical future client/profile/roles/grants/tool configuration. Only the literal strategy source differs within the reviewed boundary.
Live worker claim_next compares all five release fields. A differing model_profile_release_sha256 prevents live-worker claims; worker_profile_release_sha256 may stay identical for the same grant.
The preview demonstrates prospective composition/control parity only, not an installed live round or native quality improvement.

futureClient.suiteFormula: sha256(json.dumps([immutable evaluator image_id, command_sha256, static assessment_sha256], separators=(",", ":")).encode())
futureClient.unchangedFields: Existing token reference, URL, timeout, other allowed paths/suites/scopes/reviews and saved-artifact binding.

hostConfiguration.applicationRuntime: Preserve existing {core_container, scope_sha256}; no new runtime allowed-path register.
hostConfiguration.development: component_suites[eligiblePath] = {evaluation, assessment}; assessment = {cases_file, scorer_file, criteria, work_evidence}.
hostConfiguration.final: Extend protocols and assessments for eligiblePath in existing final_component_assessments; retain receipt_root, scope_sha256, publisher, original assessors/publishers and all old round files.

pending: Exact future-client SHA and normal factory/profile/tool readback
Host-owned execution-admission and final assessment configuration with that profile
Reviewed producer admission, full export, shared counters and stop/authorization proof
priorBindingOrder: Fix existing cases/scorers/criteria/resource/registration bytes and trusted static evaluator image/command.
Compute stable assessment identity excluding runtime_bindings and observed baseline hashes; compute new suite and future client.
Use exact same future client bytes and normal factory for both baseline/candidate; bind actual provider roles/grant plus full five-field release selector and tool configuration.
Record immutable scope/profile/source/case/session/ingress/run identities and physical shared request/tool fences before input.
Collect fully measured reference work once, seal its evidence and trusted run_bindings files, then construct fresh host assessment with exact runtime_bindings and baseline pins.
Activate reviewed host/client configuration once after the complete binding review; retain consumed rounds and receipts.

resourceQualification.tokenCeiling: Unchanged measured acceptance/stop ceiling. Codex transport does not enforce an in-flight output-token bound. Overshoot or unknown usage ends further dispatch and is NOT_MET/incomplete, never reset or estimated.
